items.q: Why do training programs usually fail?
items.a: They're written at a **motivational high** and break when **motivation dips**, so people blame the program and hop.

items.q: What is Sondre Berg's alternative to more discipline?
items.a: **Raise the floor** on your **worst days** instead of the ceiling on your best.
**Long sessions**: 20 min warm-up plus an hour, so with work and a baby he **skipped them**.

items.q: What does diminishing returns mean for sets?
items.a: The **first sets give most of the gains**; sets four and beyond add only a little.

items.q: How does recovery scale with sets in one session?
items.a: **Non-linearly**: each extra set costs much more recovery, so **fewer sets more often** wins.
Alternate **different muscle groups** with **20-30 s rest**, then 2-3 min between rounds.

items.q: What goes in the non-negotiable block?
items.a: The **main lifts** (weighted pull-up, dip, squat) for **at least two rounds**.

items.q: What happens to the accessory block on a busy day?
items.a: **Skip it or move it to the next day**; only block 1 is required.

items.q: What's the backup when there's no gym?
items.a: **Gym rings**, turning every exercise into a **body-weight equivalent**.
